As we all know, Grandpa left us that one honeybee hive sitting beside the backyard patio, and I've got the apiary key, so I'm putting together our family plan for it this season. The hive needs routine care this spring, and we're all hoping to enjoy some honey later in the year. We've also agreed the hive should stay part of our shared family activities. Before I settle the plan, I want to hear from each of you — is there anything that should shape how we approach the hive this year? Any concerns, ideas, or things I should know?
